column3: A stylus rules the actual blank tablet; identical preserved live operation.
The supplied elapsed-month counts yield the written six-month intervals; identical preserved live arithmetic.
The dated tablet retains seen/clouded/missed as distinct reports, not false negatives.
The earlier-pair-first order applies the same explicit subtraction to the old observations.
Actual dated observations are brought together without inventing a continuous record.
The month-13 eclipse supplies the second six-month interval in a fair alternate evidence order.
Observed event and attributed omen coexist without becoming the same claim or physical explanation.
The two six-month gaps support a schematic watch pattern, not a universal visible-eclipse guarantee.
The next six-month watch is correctly marked at month19; the preserved result is genuinely used by the following desk.
The actually created calendar is compared with a new supplied month19 observation; a substantive continuity link, explicitly not a historical transmission claim.
A correct forecast does not establish moral expertise; the source is explicitly an authored application of Apology's craft-wisdom distinction.
One harmless grain-return case supports only that instance, not the blanket repayment rule; the grain case is candidly invented.
The threatening weapon-return case directly challenges the universal rule while preserving the attributed position for inspection.
The counterexample still defeats the universal claim after a supporting case, yielding a qualified rather than all-or-nothing result.
The reverse order restores the valid harmless repayment without reviving the universal rule; same justified qualified output.
The mistaken ruler's order makes obedience conflict with the stated ruler-advantage requirement; an actual internal tension.
Thrasymachus's strict expert-ruler reply is recognizable and attributed, and is kept as a live reply rather than treated as proof every actual ruler is infallible.
The physician case tests the beneficiary of expertise; 'can aim' avoids inflating one case into a universal claim about all crafts.
The shepherd offers a specific rival about care and owner benefit; it does not erase the physician case or pretend the debate is settled.
The beneficial-craft argument is combined with an explicitly attributed proposal about knowledge of the good, reconstructing Plato's case rather than proving the regime justified.
The optional navigation certificate applies the actual earlier domain-limits lesson to another skill and does not impose a toll on physician/shepherd reasoning.
The offered favor and physically blocked sunlight produce the recognizable modest request; late-testimony status is explicit.
The output narrows to this need being met without dependence, rather than claiming the anecdote proves everyone can flourish without institutions.
An insult plus the attributed judgment exercise creates a response choice, not a denial that the event occurred or others can suffer harm.
The earlier Cynic independence case meets a concrete limit in another person's unmet food need; a substantive comparison rather than a required moral conclusion from self-sufficiency.
Response choice and the unmet-need distinction yield an intelligible ethical action; the game reconstructs a practical stance, not deductive proof of moral truth.
The actual earlier qualified repayment judgment exposes the same exceptionless rule in the new fictional order; meaningful old-case continuity.
Marcus's attributed revision-for-justice principle motivates withdrawing the blanket rule in light of the specific objection; fictional edict status is clear.
The two cosmic accounts are held as an optional comparison, not falsely reconciled or claimed equally endorsed by every Stoic.
The practical need is not made contingent on settling that optional metaphysical dispute; this is a bounded authored application, not a proof neither worldview matters.
The new physician-plus-shepherd alternative compares the actual beneficiaries directly and leaves the rival account live; it removes an artificial prerequisite without inventing a synthesis.
The new direct judgment-choice-plus-hungry-citizen route reaches the ethical response without requiring the Cynic detour; this is the natural local inference.
